mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.book_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.parent_id, c.create_time, u.nick_name FROM book_comment c LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_comment (book_id, user_id, content, parent_id, create_time) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, NOW())
